title: The affine mean may have nonzero U while the perturbation remains U-free
statement: For every finite r>=3/4,EVERY full affine mean A and EVERY nonzero actual periodic L4 gradient G with U(G)=0,the producer proves <J_r(A+G)> >J_r(A). The ORIGINAL density is unchanged;U(A) need not vanish. Unique A=sI+T_rM has s=U(A)/(r+2),M symmetric;G=T_r Hess psi. Exact identity Jr(I+T_rS)/(kappa sigma^2)=P_r(S)+3detS/(r sigma)-q/sigma^2+(r+3)/(2r sigma^2) adds only affine/determinant null terms on actual Hessians. For s!=0 homogeneity reduces to admitted P_r at meanM/s,potentialpsi/s;s0uses leading H_r. Positive reduced heat Gram and compatibility show vanishing twelve features forces constant Hessian;heat smoothing earns strictness also for rough fields. NO uniform all-background modulus for P_r is inferred. A possible uncorrected general-U failure in this r range must involve nonconstant normal perturbation,not merely changing mean.
